title: Time-Sensitive
description: Carry this sealed prophecy to the High Chronist in Thornfield. It warns of a mill wheel that has likely already cracked, and the road is long and worked by bandits. I send it anyway - what we saw coming gets written down regardless.

objectives.description: Receive the sealed prophecy from the Priest

notes: The line's worst prior failure: an asserted deadline ('before nightfall') with no clock and no consequence for lateness. Fixed per directive - there is no timer, and the priest's own doctrine is that lateness was never in question. Threat: the mill wheel the prophecy warns of breaks regardless of the player's speed. Giver motive: Chronos's faithful record foreseen harm even when they cannot prevent it - the record is what teaches the next warning to be trusted. Consequence: the warning lands after the fact every time; nothing in the data changes with speed, which is the point, not an oversight. Known duplicate of the root file temple_prophecy_chronos, deliberately differentiated - this copy concerns the Thornfield mill wheel and is the temple's own doctrinal business; the root copy concerns a different prophecy and a different day.
